final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT trans.account_id, AVG(trans.amount) as avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY trans.account_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT step1.account_id, step1.avg_amount, step1.avg_amount - step2.overall_avg as difference FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.avg_amount > step2.overall_avg ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
